correctness.rationale: Over C, adjunction with K=-F gives C²=2p_a(C)-2+F·C. A negative horizontal irreducible curve therefore has degree one and is a (-1)-section; the two classified section groups have order one. The only reducible fiber is II*, so the nine (-2) components and the zero section exhaust the negative curves. The section meets the unique multiplicity-one tip. Independently, let Q be the negative of the fiber matrix and D the diagonal matrix of its multiplicities m. Then DQD is the weighted tree Laplacian with conductance m_u m_v on edge uv. This proves positive semidefiniteness with a one-dimensional radical and proves positivity of all proper fiber submatrices. Grounding one omitted node i, the inverse diagonal at F8 is the path resistance from F8 to i, because m_8=1; take 0 if i=8. Summing 1/(m_u m_v) along the unique path gives 5/6, 8/9, 7/8, 1, 4/5, 3/4, 2/3, 1/2, 0 in index order. Thus among supports with the section and eight fiber curves, only the one omitting F3 has zero Schur complement. Any support with the section omitting at least two fiber curves is a principal subset of a positive definite support obtained by omitting a single i other than 3. The full fiber is singular, both alone and as a principal obstruction in the ten-curve support. An independent exact enumeration using these path resistances gives excluded masks 511, 1015, 1023 with bit 9 for the section, and size counts (1,10,45,120,210,252,210,120,45,8,0). This also agrees with independent rational LDL on the 1,024 principal matrices. Bauer–Funke–Neumann Proposition 1.1 and the empty nef support finish the count. The proof and replay are confined to these surfaces and this support invariant; the finite calculation does not by itself establish the geometric inventory. The frozen artifacts/verify.py and artifacts/verification.log were inspected as supplied evidence, not executed.

value.rationale: Chamber supports are natural birational-geometric data controlling the possible negative parts of big divisors. For a classified pair of surfaces with different residual fibers, the marked E8 configuration yields the same full size refinement and an exact list of forbidden supports, not just an isolated count. In particular the nonsaturating nine-curve support is identified by the specific multiplicity-two tip and gives a useful criterion for recognizing all allowed negative parts on both surfaces. The contribution is bounded to this pair.
